claim.claim-text: 1. A CO<2>-steam reforming process comprising contacting a gaseous mixture comprising one or more hydrocarbons including methane, together with CO<2> and H<2>O as oxidants, with a catalyst to produce a stream of a synthesis gas product having a molar H<2>:CO ratio from 1.5:1 to 2.3:1,

wherein the contacting is performed under reforming conditions including a temperature from 649°C (1200°F) to 816°C (1500°F) and a gauge pressure from 0 kPa to 517 kPa (75 psig), and wherein, under said reforming conditions, the catalyst is sufficiently active to achieve a conversion of the methane of at least 85% by reaction with CO<2> and H<2>O as the oxidants at a temperature of 704°C (1300°F).
2. The process of claim 1, wherein the catalyst comprises a solid support comprising cerium oxide and having Pt and Rh deposited thereon, each in an amount from 0.05% to 5% by weight of the catalyst.
3. The process of claim 1, wherein the molar H<2>:CO ratio, and a conversion of the one or more hydrocarbons of at least 85%, are maintained for at least 500 hours of operation.
4. The process of claim 1, wherein the gaseous mixture comprises at least 100 mol-ppm of total sulfur.
5. The process of claim 1, wherein the gaseous mixture comprises aromatic and olefinic hydrocarbons in a combined amount from 1 mol-% to 25 mol-%.
6. The process of claim 1, wherein the gaseous mixture comprises natural gas from a renewable methane source.

7. The process of claim 1, wherein the contacting is performed by flowing the gaseous mixture through a reactor vessel containing the catalyst, at a weight hourly space velocity (WHSV) from 0.1 hr<-1> to 2.5 hr<-1>, to provide the synthesis gas product as an effluent from the reactor.

8. A CO<2>-steam reforming process comprising contacting a stream of a gaseous mixture comprising one or more hydrocarbons including methane, together with CO<2> and H<2>O as oxidants with a catalyst to produce a stream of a synthesis gas product, the process further comprising:

determining a molar H<2>:CO ratio of the synthesis gas product and, based on the molar H<2>:CO ratio, adjusting a molar H<2>O:CO<2> ratio of the gaseous mixture toward a target molar H<2>:CO ratio of the synthesis gas product, wherein the contacting is performed under reforming conditions including a temperature from 649°C (1200°F) to 816°C (1500°F) and a gauge pressure from 0 kPa to 517 kPa (75 psig), and wherein, under said reforming conditions, the catalyst is sufficiently active to achieve a conversion of the methane of at least 95% by reaction with CO<2> and H<2>O as the oxidants at a temperature of 760°C (1400°F).
9. The process of claim 8, wherein the reforming conditions include a temperature from 649°C (1200°F) to 760°C (1400°F).
10. The process of claim 8, wherein the catalyst comprises a noble metal on a solid support comprising cerium oxide.
11. The process of claim 10, wherein the cerium oxide is present in an amount of at least 95% by weight of the solid support.
12. The process of claim 10, wherein the noble metal is selected from the group consisting of Pt, Rh, Ru, Pd, Ag, Os, Ir, and Au.
13. The process of claim 12, wherein the catalyst comprises at least two noble metals selected from the group consisting of Pt, Rh, Ru, Pd, Ag, Os, Ir, and Au.
14. The process of claim 13, wherein the at least two noble metals are Pt and Rh.
15. The process of claim 14, wherein the Pt is present in an amount from 0.05% to 5% by weight of the catalyst.
16. The process of claim 14, wherein the Rh is present in an amount from 0.05% to 5% by weight of the catalyst.
